export async function mapLimit(items, width, operation) {
  let next = 0;
  const results = [];
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      results[index] = await (operation as { run: (item: unknown) => Promise<unknown> }).run(items[index]);
    }
  }));
  return results;
}
